title: "Aggregate vessel and overpass data from Sentinel-2"

## Summary
Here we aggregate the Sentinel-2 data to 0.5 by 0.5 degree and calculate the number of detections per "look" by joining to overpass data.

Data source: https://globalfishingwatch.org/data-download/datasets/public-sentinel2-vessel-detections%3Av1.0 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(qs)
library(janitor)
library(h3jsr)   
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(h3)
library(glue)


source(here("R/dir.R"))

data_grid_raw <- read.csv(here("data/model_features/global_grid.csv"))

data_grid <- data_grid_raw %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(pixel_id, lon, lat)
```

```{r}
years <- c(2019:2024)

length_levels <- c("Less than 6m","6-12m","12-24m","24-50m","Over 50m")
round_to_half <- function(x) {
  round(x * 2) / 2
}

for(yr in years){
# read in smallest data and take a look
vessels <- fread(glue(file.path(rdsi_raw_dir, "global_fishing_watch/sentinel_2_data/sentinel2_vessel_detections_pipev3_{yr}.csv")))

# colnames(vessels)
#  [1] "detect_id"                "scene_id"                 "lat"                      "lon"                     
#  [5] "detect_timestamp"         "speed_kn_inferred"        "heading_deg_inferred"     "length_m_inferred"       
#  [9] "presence_score"           "nonvessel_score"          "cloud_score"              "likely_infrastructure"   
# [13] "potential_ice"            "matching_score"           "matching_score_secondary" "matching_confidence"     
# [17] "mmsi"                     "ais_lat_before"           "ais_lat_after"            "ais_lon_before"          
# [21] "ais_lon_after"            "ais_speed_kn_before"      "ais_speed_kn_after"       "ais_course_before"       
# [25] "ais_course_after"         "ais_timestamp_before"     "ais_timestamp_after"      "ais_length_m"   

# detections: data.table with columns: lon, lat, detected_at (POSIXct or Date), length_class, etc.
# overpass:   data.table with columns: h3_id (base32), month (YYYYMM integer or string), overpasses_...

setDT(vessels)

vessels_df <- vessels %>%
   filter(likely_infrastructure == "FALSE", # remove any infrastructure
         potential_ice == "FALSE", # remove any ice
         presence_score >= 0.5,
         nonvessel_score < 0.5) %>% # only keep those with high presence score and those that are vessels
    # mutate(year = as.character(as_date(floor_date(as_date(detect_timestamp), unit = "year")))) %>%
    mutate(year = yr) %>%   # integer 2025, 2024, ...
    mutate(length_class = case_when(
        length_m_inferred <6 ~ "Less than 6m",
    length_m_inferred >=6 & length_m_inferred < 12 ~ "6-12m",
    length_m_inferred >=12 & length_m_inferred < 24 ~ "12-24m",
    length_m_inferred >= 24 & length_m_inferred < 50 ~ "24-50m",
    length_m_inferred >=50 ~ "Over 50m"
  )) %>%
  dplyr::select(lon, lat, length_class, presence_score, nonvessel_score, likely_infrastructure, potential_ice, matching_score, matching_confidence, mmsi, year)

non_mmsi_keep <- vessels_df %>%
  filter(is.na(mmsi))

mmsi_remove <- vessels_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(mmsi), 
         matching_confidence >= 0.5) # remove any that have mmsi, assuming these are industrial vessels

mmsi_keep <- vessels_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(mmsi),
         matching_confidence < 0.5) # only keep mmsi if the matching confidence is low

vessels_df_fin <- rbind(non_mmsi_keep, mmsi_keep) %>%
  dplyr::select(lon, lat, length_class, year)

## aggregate to 0.5 degrees

# Aggregate from 0.1 to 0.5 degree cells
vessels_agg_5 <- vessels_df_fin %>%
  # Round coordinates to nearest 0.5 degree
  mutate(
    x_05 = round_to_half(lon),
    y_05 = round_to_half(lat)
  ) %>%
  # Group by rounded coordinates and existing grouping variables
  group_by(x_05, y_05, year, length_class) %>%
  # Aggregate numeric columns
  summarise(
    nv = n() # Sum the vessel counts
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Rename coordinates back to original names if needed
  rename(lon = x_05, lat = y_05) %>%
  as.data.table()


# test <-  vessels_agg_5 %>%
#   dplyr::select(lon, lat, nv) %>%
#   rast(., type = "xyz")
#   
# plot(test)

## now we need to match to the overpass data so that we can determine valid detections 
overpass <- fread(glue(file.path(rdsi_raw_dir, "global_fishing_watch/sentinel_2_data/overpass_data/sentinel2_overpass_{yr}.csv")))

## aggregate overpass data to 0.5 and yearly

h3_ids <- unique(overpass$h3_id)

ll <- as.data.frame(h3_to_geo(h3_ids))

names(ll) <- c("lat", "lon")
h3_id_lookup <- data.frame(h3_id = h3_ids, lon = ll$lon, lat = ll$lat, row.names = NULL) # will we need to do this everytime or do the cells not change? 

overpass_agg <- overpass %>%
  left_join(h3_id_lookup) %>%
    mutate(
    x_05 = round_to_half(lon),
    y_05 = round_to_half(lat),
    year = yr
  ) %>%
  # Group by rounded coordinates and existing grouping variables
  group_by(x_05, y_05, year) %>%
  # Aggregate numeric columns
  summarise(
    looks = n() # Sum the vessel counts
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Rename coordinates back to original names if needed
  rename(lon = x_05, lat = y_05) %>%
  as.data.table()

# test <- overpass_agg %>%
#   dplyr::select(lon, lat, looks) %>%
#   rast(.,type = "xyz")
  
# Expand overpasses to all vessel length classes (effort is class-agnostic)
looks_05_expand <- overpass_agg[, .(length_class = length_levels), by = .(lon, lat, year, looks)]

setkey(vessels_agg_5, lon, lat, year, length_class)
setkey(looks_05_expand,   lon, lat, year)

vessels_agg_5_new <- vessels_agg_5 %>%
  full_join(looks_05_expand) %>%
  mutate(D = ifelse(is.na(nv), 0, nv),
         looks = ifelse(is.na(looks), 0, looks)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-nv)

# sum(vessels_agg_5_new$D, na.rm = TRUE) # 7276446
# sum(vessels_agg_5$nv, na.rm = TRUE) # 7276446

## ok now we need to gapfill any of the cells which have 0 looks but detections. we will gapfill with the nearest neighbor cells looks fro the same month/year

# Input: vessels_agg_5_new with columns:
# lon, lat, year, length_class, D, looks  (0.5° bins)
# helper
wrap180 <- function(x) ((x + 180) %% 360) - 180

# rows needing fill
need <- unique(vessels_agg_5_new[D > 0 & looks == 0, .(lon, lat, year)])

  # length-agnostic lookup of looks
  L <- unique(vessels_agg_5_new[, .(lon, lat, year, looks)])
  setkey(L, year, lon, lat)

  # 8-neighbor offsets (queen)
  offs <- CJ(dx = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), dy = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5))[!(dx == 0 & dy == 0)]

  # cross-join need × offs via a dummy key 'k'
  need_nb <- need[, .(lon0 = lon, lat0 = lat, year)][, k := 1L]
  offs[, k := 1L]
  need_nb <- need_nb[offs, on = "k", allow.cartesian = TRUE][, k := NULL]

  # compute neighbor coords
  need_nb[, `:=`(
    lon = wrap180(lon0 + dx),
    lat =        (lat0 + dy)
  )][, c("dx","dy") := NULL]

  # join neighbor looks
  nb <- L[need_nb, on = .(year, lon, lat)]

  # max looks across neighbors (use median() if you prefer)
  looks_fill <- nb[, .(looks_nb = suppressWarnings(max(looks, na.rm = TRUE))),
                   by = .(lon0, lat0, year)]
  looks_fill[is.infinite(looks_nb), looks_nb := NA_integer_]

  # apply fills back to all length_class rows in that cell-month
  setkey(looks_fill, lon0, lat0, year)
  setkey(vessels_agg_5_new, lon, lat, year)

  vessels_agg_5_new <- looks_fill[vessels_agg_5_new]
  vessels_agg_5_new[
    D > 0 & looks == 0,
    looks := fifelse(!is.na(looks_nb) & looks_nb > 0, as.integer(looks_nb), 1L)
  ]
  vessels_agg_5_new[, looks_nb := NULL]

vessels_agg_5_new <- vessels_agg_5_new %>%
  rename(lon = lon0, lat = lat0) %>%
  left_join(data_grid)

# test <- vessels_agg_5_new %>%
#   filter(is.na(pixel_id)) %>%
#   distinct(lon, lat) %>%
#   mutate(sample = 1) %>%
#   rast(., type = "xyz")
# 
# plot(test) # cool this is the sampling area

# Ok, after joining with data_grid, we see that some pixel_ids are NA. This is because they are all very close to the shore. So we need to assign these cells to the closest pixel_id. 


# put your data in a data.table
dt <- as.data.table(vessels_agg_5_new)

# indices of rows with/without pixel_id
idx_missing <- which(is.na(dt$pixel_id))

  known <- dt[!is.na(pixel_id), .(lon, lat, pixel_id)]
  # build matrices of coordinates
  known_xy <- as.matrix(known[, .(lon, lat)])
  miss_xy  <- as.matrix(dt[idx_missing, .(lon, lat)])

  # 1-nearest neighbor for each missing row
  nn <- RANN::nn2(data = known_xy, query = miss_xy, k = 1)

  # fill pixel_id from nearest known neighbor
  dt[idx_missing, pixel_id := known$pixel_id[nn$nn.idx]]

  # optional sanity check
  message("NAs before: ", sum(is.na(vessels_agg_5_new$pixel_id)),
          " | NAs after: ", sum(is.na(dt$pixel_id)))

# result in dt; if you want it back as data.frame:
vessels_agg_5_new_filled <- as.data.frame(dt) %>%
  dplyr::select(-lon, -lat) %>%
  left_join(data_grid) %>%
  group_by(lon, lat, pixel_id, year, length_class) %>%
  summarise(D = sum(D, na.rm = TRUE), 
            looks = sum(looks, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

qs::qsave(vessels_agg_5_new_filled, glue(here("data/detections_looks/sentinel2_detections_looks_{yr}.qs")))

}

```
